title: CIP: Improve connection analysis
description:
- Forward Open Request
  - Show all generated connection info under a tree (like similar functions)
  - Show OT, TO timeouts
  - Show matching Forward Close frame
  - Or, show if no Forward Close was found
- Forward Close Request
  - Use this to indicate a connection is closed, instead of the Response
  - Only mark the first message as the close frame, for a given connection
- Extract Method for: display_connection_information_fwd_close_rsp, display_connection_information_fwd_open_rsp
